test.entry: Public /games/tarot at 390px -> Start reading -> three actual server-owned card choices

checks: Both real calculated charts preview and persist with the generated analysis
Complete card, astrology and next-step sections render at 320px, 390px and 1440px without document overflow
All three selected reference images match exact catalogue name/source/image/alt and decode successfully; the 390px capture was visually reviewed
Saved reading data and visible text remain identical after refresh, a new spread and room closure
Independent outsider receives 404 and no private reading content; owner profile history retains the reading
One request completes through automatic Gemini-to-Cloudflare fallback with visible estimated progress and remaining time
limitations: This hosted request used Gemini and Cloudflare; it did not force a Groq attempt. Separate direct provider evaluations establish the Groq Vedic/Both evidence.
The Cloudflare output is usable and structurally complete, but still question-led and less specific/actionable than a stronger reading.
The three selected portraits were checked; this is not an inspection of every catalogue image or every possible generated reading.
Duration includes browser observation and saved-result readback; it is not an isolated provider inference measurement.

evidence.progress: Timestamped rendered DOM frames plus the UI natural GET responses
evidence.privacy: Private identifiers, questions and generated prose remain only in ignored artifacts.
